snippet.title: Spider-Bot | Splinter Cell Blacklist | Companion App
snippet.description:
Available Now: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/splinter-cell-blacklist-spider/id648356859?mt=8

Find out more about Splinter Cell Blacklist Spider-bot game modes! Ghost, panther or assault, get ready for the fight.

Splinter Cell Blacklist is now available on Xbox 360, Playstation 3, PC and WiiU.
